document.getElementById('bl-domain-tag').textContent = 'Domain ' + q.domain_num + ' — ' + q.domain_name; document.getElementById('bl-task-tag').textContent = 'Task ' + q.task_num + ': ' + q.task_name; document.getElementById('bl-next-btn').style.display = 'none'; } function pickBaselineAnswer(letter, btn) { if (baselineAnswered) return; baselineAnswered = true; const q = baselineQs[baselineIdx]; const correctLetter = q._shuffledCorrect || q.correct; const correct = letter === correctLetter; baselineAnswers[baselineIdx].correct = correct; // Track enabler as seen if (q.task_num && q.enabler_num) { if (!scores[q.task_num]) scores[q.task_num] = { correct: 0, total: 0, enablers_seen: [] }; if (!scores[q.task_num].enablers_seen) scores[q.task_num].enablers_seen = []; if (!scores[q.task_num].enablers_seen.includes(q.enabler_num)) { scores[q.task_num].enablers_seen.push(q.enabler_num); } } document.querySelectorAll('#bl-answers button').forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; if (b.dataset.l === correctLetter) { b.style.borderColor='rgba(0,200,160,0.5)'; b.style.background='rgba(0,180,140,0.15)'; b.style.color='#00d0b0'; } }); if (!correct) { btn.style.borderColor='rgba(255,80,80,0.5)'; } const nb = document.getElementById('bl-next-btn'); nb.style.display = 'block'; nb.textContent = baselineIdx === baselineQs.length - 1 ? 'See My Results →' : 'Next Question →'; } function nextBaselineQ() { baselineIdx++; if (baselineIdx >= baselineQs.length) finishBaselineQuiz(); else renderBaselineQ(); } async function finishBaselineQuiz() { baselineAnswers.forEach(a => { if (!scores[a.task]) scores[a.task] = { correct: 0, total: 0, enablers_seen: [] }; if (!scores[a.task].enablers_seen) scores[a.task].enablers_seen = []; scores[a.task].total++; if (a.correct) scores[a.task].correct++; // Carry over enablers_seen tracked during pickBaselineAnswer // They are already in scores[a.task].enablers_seen from real-time tracking }); if (profile) profile.questions_answered = (profile.questions_answered || 0) + baselineQs.length; const taskResults = {}; baselineAnswers.forEach(a => { if (!taskResults[a.task]) taskResults[a.task] = { correct: 0, total: 0 }; taskResults[a.task].total++; if (a.correct) taskResults[a.task].correct++; }); const totalCorrect = baselineAnswers.filter(a => a.correct).length; const pct = Math.round(totalCorrect / baselineAnswers.length * 100); await saveExamData(taskResults, { type: 'Baseline Quiz', score: pct, correct: totalCorrect, total: baselineAnswers.length, duration: 0 }); document.getElementById('baseline-question').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('baseline-results').style.display = 'block'; document.getElementById('bl-overall-score').textContent = pct + '%'; document.getElementById('bl-results-breakdown').innerHTML = [1,2,3].map(dn => { const d = DOMAINS[dn]; const dTasks = d.tasks.filter(t => taskResults[t]); if (!dTasks.length) return ''; return '
Domain ' + dn + ' — ' + d.name + '
' + dTasks.map(t => { const r = taskResults[t]; const p = Math.round(r.correct/r.total*100); const m = mastery(p); return '
Task ' + t + ': ' + TASKS[t] + '
' + p + '%
' + m.label + '
'; }).join('') + '
'; }).join(''); document.getElementById('baseline-results').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } async function finishBaseline() { if (user) { await SB.from('users').update({ baseline_complete: true }).eq('id', user.id); if (profile) profile.baseline_complete = true; } document.getElementById('screen-baseline').style.display = 'none'; goView('dashboard'); } //
